reason: 该仓库主要是一个面向用户的桌面化外壳插件，将 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web UI 封装在 Electron 窗口中并通过 dsh 插件机制安装与启动。证据来自 README 对“原生桌面套壳”和插件化安装流程的说明、package.json 的入口与 dsh bundle patch 声明，以及树中主进程与内核/插件模块结构。其核心用途是本地桌面启动和会话入口，不属于生成、检索或学习型功能。

summaries.zh: dsh-gui 是一个将 DeepSeek Harness 官方 Web UI 运行在本机 Electron 桌面窗口中的应用，并可作为 dsh 插件包安装以快速启动和访问本地 GUI。
summaries.en: dsh-gui is a native Electron desktop wrapper for the official DeepSeek Harness web UI and can be installed as a dsh profile bundle for quick local GUI startup.

capabilities: local dsh process/subprocess orchestration via CLI
HTTP/WebSocket bridge to local or configured dsh host
plugin loading with manifest-based IPC permissions

reasons.code: README describes an Electron-based native desktop shell that loads the official DeepSeek Harness Web UI and is installable as a dsh profile bundle
Package metadata sets the package entry for Electron main process and declares a dsh bundle patch for plugin installation behavior
Repository tree includes dedicated kernel, plugin, bridge, and host-management modules for protocol handling and extension loading
README documents automatic desktop shortcut refresh, dsh web process startup/port handling, and configurable host URL/ports, indicating host control and local file/shortcut side effects

capabilities: local dsh process/subprocess orchestration via CLI
HTTP/WebSocket bridge to local or configured dsh host
plugin loading with manifest-based IPC permissions
